limitations: Native holds and world seams are exact motion states; all nine camera cuts intentionally change the view.
Boundary pixel differences measure changed views, not just codec error, and are not judged against a small-difference threshold.
H.264 and JPEG are lossy; raw and decoded differences are recorded without invented acceptance thresholds.
Contacts and technical checks do not certify full-speed comfort or artistic acceptance.
